items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I went to dance at the fairground and I can't forget that Papa Sutterstein used to use a big two by four to start the band off... And the band you know started playing... I said it used to tickle me.

ctx.x: Yeah and I went to dance at the fairground and I can't forget that Papa Sutterstein used to use a big two by four to start the band off. Oh really? It was a big band you know. Big brass band and so he hit on the side of the bandstand bam bam bam. And the band you know started playing so many licks the band would start. I said it used to tickle me. Make sure they all heard when the signal was stopped you know. I mean Papa used to tickle me with that. Lewis Armstrong was right side of Papa blowing that trumpet. And…
How long have you been with this band you're playing with now? The uh. Papa Sutterstein?
